ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Akme Fintrade (India) Limited reported strong financial performance for the half year ended September 30, 2026, with significant year-on-year growth in total income (30.6%) and net profit (19.5%). This robust growth was primarily fueled by a substantial expansion of its loan book (up approximately 14% in six months), largely financed by a considerable increase in debt securities (up 72% over the same period), leading to a material rise in finance costs. While the rapid, debt-funded asset growth indicates increasing leverage that warrants careful monitoring, the unaudited results received a clean limited review report from the statutory auditors.
